title: US Traffic Ticket Courts and Payment Portals
subtitle: 185 cities / 21 states: courts, official payment portals, points, traffic-school rules
description:
A machine-readable reference for what to do after a US traffic ticket: 185 city records across 21 states, plus 21 state records.

Each city record names the court or agency that actually handles the citation and links to that agency's own official payment or contest portal - no third-party payment services - plus the fine structure, the point consequences, contest options, and the facts still unverified.

Each state record covers the point system and whether a traffic course dismisses the case, withholds adjudication, only reduces points, or does not exist.

Also available as a key-less JSON API: https://api.ticketsimplified.com/index.json
